title: Zero added cost preserves the distribution
statement: For any type of outputs and any probability mass function on pairs consisting of an output and a learning cost, mapping each pair to the same output with zero added to its cost leaves the probability mass function unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function on output-and-learning-cost pairs
